geography.landform: Fractured continents and floating rock islands above an atmospheric void

magnetic_fields.behavior: Erratic and turbulent in motion, but their patterns are predictable.

humanity.adaptation: Survivors evolved over generations under the influence of the magnetic fields.

gravity_and_energy.fictional_physics: These are rules of the setting; no real-world scientific mechanism is established.

Elder baron is bald and grey-bearded, exiled not executed; Duke Ferdinand is a different dark-haired gold-mantled man.
Ordinary officers only in page24 council. Three naval captains are distinct from five silver Type C knights.
Preserve canonical house palettes, varied geography and the limited scope of the emerging reforms. No ninth duchy or final borders.

STYLE: Magneton graphic novel: painted ink, tactile bronze machinery, silver Type C, crimson Veymarch cloth, navy/gold Auric Reach uniforms; atmospheric floating islands. Consistent with supplied scene references, not photorealistic.
